name: Become the Pilot
oracle_text:
Enchant noncommander creature
You control enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and can't be blocked unless it's attacking its owner or a permanent its owner controls.
blocked_sentences: Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and can't be blocked unless it's attacking its owner or a permanent its owner controls.

needs.what: a static control-changing effect (Control Magic) whose affects is the attached permanent: the Aura's controller controls the enchanted creature for as long as the Aura is attached to it, and control reverts when the Aura leaves or moves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has no control-changing effect; the gain_control op is one-shot and its durations (permanent, until_end_of_turn, as_long_as_you_control_source) do not end when the Aura becomes unattached, and an enters trigger would miss a later re-attach and leave control behind when the Aura moves

needs.what: a static evasion grant on the enchanted creature: it can't be blocked unless the player or planeswalker/battle it is attacking is its owner or a permanent its owner controls
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the unblockable op is one-shot with except_blockers filtering blockers, not the attacked seat; block_restriction / cant_block statics have no key comparing the defending player to the creature's owner
